name: herd-delegation
description: Delegate one unit of work to an agent in its own Herdr tab and drive that pane as a real terminal: when a pane beats a background subagent, the tab-per-agent rule, the brief with an ask-in-the-pane clause instead of a stop clause, reading and answering a live pane, the alternate-screen trap and its file fallback, and the two things that stay with the parent (secret values, human consent).
